name: Sully.ai
description: Sully.ai is a Khosla-backed healthcare AI platform offering multiple AI 'agents' beyond scribing—AI Scribe, AI Receptionist, AI Medical Coder, AI Nurse, AI Interpreter. Pro tier at $79/provider/month includes AI Scribe, AI Chat, custom templates, and 24/7 support. Premium tier at $99/provider/month adds EHR Integration Agent, Decision Support, and Research/Writer/Interpreter agents. Free trial with 10 visits/month. 50+ specialty support including primary care, cardiology, dermatology. Native EHR integrations with Epic, Cerner, MEDITECH, athenahealth, NextGen, DrChrono, AdvancedMD, Kareo, ModMed. Generates SOAP notes, orders, billing codes, and patient instructions in one pass. 85-95% accuracy on initial drafts.

faqs.q: How much does Sully.ai cost in 2026?
faqs.a: Sully.ai Pro costs $79/provider/month (AI Scribe, AI Chat, custom templates). Premium costs $99/provider/month (adds EHR Integration, Decision Support, Research agents). Free trial includes 10 visits/month.

faqs.q: What makes Sully.ai different from other AI scribes?
faqs.a: Sully.ai is a multi-agent platform—beyond scribing, it offers AI Receptionist (patient calls), AI Medical Coder (claims), AI Nurse (intake/triage), and AI Interpreter (multilingual). Most competitors focus only on documentation.

faqs.q: What EHRs does Sully.ai integrate with?
faqs.a: Native integrations include Epic, Cerner (Oracle Health), MEDITECH, athenahealth, NextGen, DrChrono, AdvancedMD, Kareo, and ModMed with bidirectional PHI sync.
Sully.ai achieves 85-95% accuracy on initial draft generation, which is typical for ambient AI platforms. Physician review and editing is still required.

faqs.q: Sully.ai vs Freed vs DeepCura: which is better?
faqs.a: Sully.ai ($79-99/mo) offers multi-agent platform with broad EHR integrations. Freed ($39-119/mo) is cheaper for pure scribing. DeepCura ($129/mo) focuses on psychiatry with MSE support. For multi-agent needs, Sully. For budget, Freed. For psychiatry, DeepCura.
